source_first_policy.rule: SOURCE FIRST -> FORMALIZE -> PREREGISTER -> EXECUTE -> REPLAY -> SEAL

modular_decomposition.mandatory_R1_use: Compute graph-only modular metadata for every corpus residual before any new descriptor interpretation.
required_metadata: canonical quotient graph by maximal strong modules
whether quotient is prime/complete/edgeless under standard modular-decomposition classification
modular_decomposition.execution_method: Because the frozen corpus has at most 13 residual vertices, an exhaustive module/strong-module verifier is permitted as proof-carrying replay even though linear-time algorithms are known.

bipartite_chain_structure.residual_rule: If the residual is independently bipartite and P7-free, record KNOWN_CHAIN_DECOMPOSABLE_BY_SOURCE_THEOREM before considering any internally invented decomposition descriptor.
bipartite_chain_structure.X_firewall: The canonical channel graph X is not automatically an induced subgraph of the P7-free residual. Never infer X is P7-free from residual P7-freeness.
bipartite_chain_structure.X_rule: For every canonical X, independently test induced-P7-freeness of X. Apply the P7-free bipartite chain theorem to X only when that test passes.
bipartite_chain_structure.non_applicable: If a residual is not bipartite, record NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_RESIDUAL rather than failure of the theorem.

required_metadata: enumerate every minimal separator of the residual exactly
compute the exact minimum closed-neighborhood cover number min{|T|: S subseteq N[T]} for the small frozen graph
record maximal-strong-module/quotient context for separator clustering
minimal_separator_cover.firewall: A <=22 closed-neighborhood cover bound is NOT a separator-size bound and does not imply bounded vertex connectivity.
minimal_separator_cover.PMC_scope: The source PMC <=68 neighborhood-cover theorem is recorded as imported background but potential maximal clique enumeration is not part of R1 unless separately preregistered.

bounded_clique_container_framework.R1_use: Metadata/reference only; do not promote it to a general 4-coloring terminal because fixed target treewidth d is required.

restricted_P7_C4_C5_decomposition.rule: May be marked applicable only for a residual independently satisfying the extra C4-free and C5-free hypotheses.

joins_and_strips.rule: May be recorded as structural similarity metadata; do not claim subsumption or create a descriptor from resemblance.

lemma11.rule: Do not import Lemma 11 as a P7 theorem.

P7_precoloring_hardness.firewall: R1 cannot be interpreted as a generic polynomial shortcut for unrestricted P7-free 4-Precoloring Extension.

P7_4color_hardness.firewall: Finite-corpus exact-channel coverage cannot be promoted to a polynomial algorithm for all P7-free 4-COLORING.

survey_domain.graph_input: Use only the exact residual graph of each frozen corpus row. Lists and C11 provenance are preserved as metadata but MUST NOT be used to choose anchors, hub, partitions, modules, separators, or exact-channel representations.
survey_domain.residual_P7_rule: Independently verify every residual graph is P7-free before source-dependent P7 metadata is applied.
survey_domain.label_order: Use the frozen residual vertex order as the canonical total order for deterministic pair orientation and certificate tie-breaking.

required: vertex/edge/list payload rebinds byte-for-byte to frozen corpus row
bipartite status and one 2-coloring if bipartite
maximal proper strong modules and quotient graph
exact closed-neighborhood cover number for each minimal separator

per_residual_phase_B_exact_channel_surve.anchor_domain: Enumerate every unordered vertex pair {c,f} exactly once.
per_residual_phase_B_exact_channel_surve.deterministic_orientation: Orient the unordered pair according to the frozen residual vertex order solely to name c/f and L/R. Reversal is graph-theoretically dual.

pair_classifier.case: unique common neighbor z but Reach_D(R0) intersects L0
pair_classifier.certificate: canonical forced-R to forced-L implication path with each arc source edge/reason

required_receipt: implication graph D or canonical arc list
minimum vertex cover U in X
local formula lambda_G(c,f)=rho+1 as imported theorem consequence
source chain-theorem applicability to X iff X is P7-free

per_residual_phase_B_exact_channel_surve.representation_space_firewall: Do NOT enumerate or count Up(H). H is the complete compact representation-space receipt; canonical R_min is sufficient for capacity.
per_residual_phase_B_exact_channel_surve.capacity_firewall: Do NOT optimize over partitions. nu(X) is invariant for the fixed anchor pair.

required_counts: nonunique_hub_fail_count separated into zero/multiple common-neighbor counts
required_distributions: rho capacity distribution across representable anchor pairs
source chain-theorem applicability count for canonical X
structural_cross_table: exact-channel coverage versus modular quotient metadata
per_residual_aggregate.interpretation: Descriptive finite-corpus matrix only. Correlation or repeated pattern does not define a new descriptor.

R1_outcome_vocabulary.survey_completion: R1_SURVEY_COMPLETE iff all 8 frozen corpus rows and every unordered anchor pair are accounted exactly once and all mandatory metadata/certificates pass independent replay.
R1_outcome_vocabulary.meaning: Coverage statuses describe only the frozen finite corpus and are not universal C11 theorems.

independent_replay_requirements: Rebind source audit and frozen corpus blobs.
Recompute graph fingerprints, P7-free checks, bipartiteness, modules/strong modules, quotient, minimal separators, and separator-cover numbers independently.
Re-enumerate every unordered anchor pair exactly once.
Recompute unique-hub prefilters and implication reachability independently.
Recompute F_R,F_L,F_star,SCC condensation H and canonical X for every PASS.
Recompute maximum matching and minimum vertex cover and verify equal cardinality.
Independently test each canonical X for induced P7 before any bipartite-P7 chain theorem applicability flag.
Assert finite-corpus ceiling and all source-driven firewalls.
forbidden: modify the frozen 8-row corpus during execution
count 256 channel-laboratory descendants as 256 separate R1 corpus rows
use lists, color extensions, or provenance coloring to choose anchors/hubs/partitions
infer X is P7-free from the residual being P7-free
apply the P7-free bipartite chain theorem to X without an independent X P7-free check
apply the P7-free bipartite chain theorem to a nonbipartite residual
interpret a <=22 neighborhood cover as a <=22 separator-size bound
define a new descriptor from R1 patterns
promote all-8 corpus coverage to all C11 residuals
claim a polynomial P7-free 4-coloring or precoloring algorithm
start R2/R3 or any successor automatically
